versions.changelog:
**v5.3.0 introduces clearly defined skill boundaries and improves user guidance:**

- Added an explicit "Out of Scope" section outlining unsupported scenarios (e.g., full article typesetting, video/motion graphics, pure image editing, fan content, hard-sell advertising, long tutorials).
- Now informs users upfront when their content falls outside the supported scenarios and suggests alternative tools.
- Updated skill philosophy and rationale to emphasize focus and quality over feature creep.
- Documentation (README.md, SKILL.md, references) revised to reflect new boundaries and reinforce intended use cases.
- No changes to core generation flows or UI/UX; all updates focus on user expectations and documentation clarity.

react-design-draft v5.2.0

- Added new reference: `references/image-sources.md` to guide image sourcing.
- Removed deprecated documentation file: `skill-card.md`.
- Updated aesthetics, density, and multi-illustration reference guides for clarity and detail.
- Refined SKILL.md to reflect new documentation structure and highlight latest guidance.
- Improved and reorganized documentation for better usability.

- Major release: Adds automatic, multi-illustration, and brand-adaptive design modes for generating React design drafts.
- New "Master Mode" for fully automated, confirmation-free generation with style auto-matching and batch previews.
- Introduces Multi-Illustration Mode (with 5-step flow, including article parsing and per-illustration edit guides).
- Enhanced brand profiling and "Brand DNA" auto-detection; now supports explicit brand style configuration.
- Expanded content readiness and quality filters; stronger checks for visualizability, density, and anti-generic writing.
- Adds references for brand profile, chart-system, and multi-illustrations; updates all guides and mappings for new workflows.
v3.0.0: Three-dimension system (25 layouts x 23 styles x 12 palettes), React 4-piece output, density scoring, local-first CJK fonts, 29 quick presets, Kami editorial style
